correctness.rationale: The p-adic lifting implication A≡B mod p^r ⇒ A^p≡B^p mod p^(r+1) holds coefficientwise, including p=2. Combining j=n−1 and j=n n-good congruences yields P(x^p)≡P(x)^p mod p^(n+1). If m is the largest non-p-divisible exponent with p^n∤b_m, then m<d and S=(p−1)d+m is not divisible by p. Its P(x^p) coefficient vanishes. Among p-tuples with degree sum S, p permutations with indices (m,d,...,d) contribute p b_m; every other tuple necessarily contains a non-p-divisible index >m and has b_i divisible p^n, while its nonconstant multinomial coefficient has p factor since p∤S. Contradiction. Sharpness P=(1+x)^(p^n) follows from freshman-dream plus n lifts, coefficient b_1=p^n. Independent direct integer-binomial coefficient congruences checked p∈{2,3,5,7} at small n (p=2 to n=3, others n≤2) and divisibility/exact sharpness; these finite examples are only corroboration.
